# `os` standard library

The `os` module provides safe, high-level abstractions over POSIX file operations,
device controls, and process execution.

```dva
#use os
```

## Function catalog

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `os::open` | `String, Int => Int` | Opens file path with flags, returning file descriptor |
| `os::close` | `Int => Int` | Closes file descriptor |
| `os::write` | `Int, String, Int => Int` | Writes string byte buffer to descriptor |
| `os::read` | `Int, Int => String` | Unbuffered read of up to `count` bytes into an immutable `String` |
| `os::ioctl` | `Int, Int, Int => Int` | Performs control device request |
| `os::spawn` | `String, Addr => Int` | Spawns external executable with `argv` pointer and waits for completion |

```dva
fd = os::open("output.txt", 577) // O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC
fd !< 0
   |
      os::write(fd, "hello\n", 6)
      os::close(fd)
```
